blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has ordered AIQuest Trading and its operator to stop soliciting public investments immediately, escalating its action over an alleged unregistered securities offering. The SEC’s Enforcement and Investor Protection Department (EIPD) issued a cease and desist order (CDO) against AIQuest Trading, Erica Aguilar, and their agents after finding prima facie evidence of ongoing violations of the Securities Regulation Code (SRC). READ: SEC warns vs loan scams impersonating registered firms The order covers the entity’s officers, representatives, salespeople, agents, operators, enablers, influencers, and other persons or entities acting on its behalf.
